A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GenHOI. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching material relocated between sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original pose-estimation results on DexYCB and HO3Dv2, component and sensitivity ablations, qualitative examples, and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and adds DexYCB S3 ADD-S comparisons and component ablations across occlusion levels.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 changes the text-feature shape from 1 × D_T to L_T × D_T, while the architecture diagram, fusion equations, masking, losses, and inference procedure remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether this corrects the description or changes the implementation from a single text vector to tokenwise features.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate DexYCB S0 and S3 and HO3Dv2, including seen/unseen objects and the same occlusion ranges. The new analyses reuse existing coverage; the S0 results move to the appendix.

E2.justification: v4 Table 2 adds HOISDF to the reported DexYCB S3 object-pose comparison alongside HFL-Net and UniHOPE. HOISDF was previously compared on S0 and HO3Dv2, but not S3. Comparator membership in the retained tables is unchanged.

E3.justification: v4 adds ADD-S in millimeters to the S3 evaluation and evaluates component ablations separately within the existing 25–50%, 50–75%, and 75–100% occlusion bins. Previously stated splits, preprocessing, training budget, and other retained experimental settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix Table C evaluates seven existing component ablations across three occlusion levels, extending the earlier aggregate component analysis. Existing masking-ratio, fusion-order, template, noise, runtime, and failure-case analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or error bars. The added tables do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: New Table 2 reports mean S3 ADD-S errors of 21.76 mm for GenHOI, 84.04 for HOISDF, 110.79 for UniHOPE, and 114.83 for HFL-Net. Appendix Table C adds occlusion-specific ablation scores. Previously reported results remain unchanged after matching relocated tables; these additions are not improvements over v1 under identical measurements.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 revises the formal text-feature definition from F_T in R^(1 × D_T) to R^(L_T × D_T). This is a limited dimensional-definition change; the displayed equations otherwise remain unchanged, with no added theorem, proof, or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about hierarchical semantics, multimodal masking, hand priors, generalization, occlusion robustness, and benchmark performance. The additional evidence does not redefine those claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B.3 adds an interpretation of the occlusion-stratified ablations, attributing robustness to semantic guidance, complementary modalities, and hand-prior regularization when visibility decreases. Existing explanations, extreme-occlusion limitations, and future directions remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The reported text-feature tensor shape is revised to L_T × D_T in Section 3.2, providing a different implementation specification without establishing an implementation change. Appendix A's hyperparameters, preprocessing, point counts, and loss weights, together with hardware and runtime disclosures, remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v4 adds Liu et al., 'Scalable unseen objects 6-dof absolute pose estimation with robotic integration,' as reference 26 in the introduction's robotic-manipulation motivation. The related-work discussion and substantive positioning otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 moves the S0 discussion into a new appendix subsection, adds short passages explaining the new results, updates author and affiliation information, fixes running headers, and adds acknowledgements. Most scientific prose remains verbatim, so this is limited reorganization and editing.

P2.justification: v4 adds the S3 ADD-S table and occlusion-stratified ablation table, and relocates v1 Tables 3–4 to Appendix Tables A–B. Other tables are renumbered and pages reflow, while the architecture diagram and qualitative figures retain their content.

improvement.justification: The new S3 ADD-S comparison includes HOISDF under a shared metric, and Appendix Table C adds targeted evidence across occlusion severity while preserving earlier results. These provide limited additional support for the paper's central claims. Table C's missing full-model row and incorrect reference to Table 5 reduce its interpretability, but do not outweigh the added comparative evidence.
